data.review_body:
I ordered four items in two packages. Today, I received one package containing four bags. Three of the bags contained items, but the fourth bag was empty.

When I contacted customer service, they told me that their system shows that the package was shipped correctly and asked me to check once again whether I had really looked properly, as if the missing dress had somehow hidden itself inside the package. I explained that I had checked everything and that the dress was not there, but they continued repeating that their system shows that everything had been packed.

I asked them to provide proof that the item had actually been shipped, but they refused to send me any evidence. They even blamed the delivery company.

I will never buy any products from SHEIN again. I have been a loyal customer for many years and have spent a lot of money on SHEIN products. That is why, in my opinion, Temu is definitely better — the quality is the same, but their willingness to help and their attitude towards customers are at a much higher level.

SHEIN is a huge disappointment for me.

data.review_body:
Extremely Disappointed – Feels Like a Scam

I received an item that arrived broken, and to make matters worse, it was marked as non-refundable. I contacted customer service, expecting them to stand behind the products sold on their platform.

First, they told me they could only offer 50% of the price as compensation. After a long back-and-forth conversation, they finally asked me to send photos of the damaged item so they could “review” the case.

Honestly, this experience feels like a scam. Isn’t it the responsibility of a marketplace like SHEIN to make sure the sellers on their platform are providing safe, undamaged products? Customers should not have to fight this hard after receiving a broken item.

I would strongly advise everyone to be very careful when shopping on this website, especially if an item is labeled non-refundable. If something arrives damaged, don’t expect an easy or fair resolution.
